resources.string: Allows JARVIS to read visible screen text, identify UI elements (buttons, text fields, lists), and perform user-requested screen actions such as tapping, typing, scrolling, and navigating apps.

Security Warning: API keys configured via BuildConfig or local prototyping storage are packaged for this device session. Android APKs can be decompiled; do not share this APK publicly if it contains a personal API key. For public production deployment, use an ephemeral token backend proxy.
